title: phpMyFAQ from 4.2.0-alpha.2 before 4.2.0-RC.2 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that lets scoped…
description: phpMyFAQ versions from 4.2.0-alpha.2 up to but not including 4.2.0-RC.2 contain an authorization vulnerability. This flaw allows scoped editors to view draft FAQs outside their assigned categories or languages because the dashboard and admin search do not enforce category/language-scoped FAQ_EDIT permissions correctly. Authenticated editors can exploit this by loading the unpublished FAQs widget with a language parameter or querying the admin API to leak draft FAQ titles, IDs, and confirm words in draft bodies. The vulnerability has a low severity score of 2.7 and does not impact integrity or availability.
